open_questions.gap: The objective was spoken as «μπραντ αγουέρνες», a probable garble of "brand awareness"; it is not confirmed as the primary objective.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The objective drives the whole strategy and how success is judged.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε ότι το βασικό σας ζητούμενο για το launch είναι το brand awareness στην κατηγορία sparkling tea;

open_questions.gap: No success metric or target (sales or awareness) exists yet; the client said nothing is written down.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a target we cannot set KPIs or show the campaign worked.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιο νούμερο ή ποιον δείκτη, σε sales ή awareness, θα θεωρήσετε ότι δείχνει πως το launch πέτυχε, και ποιος θα τον ορίσει μαζί μας;

open_questions.gap: The speaker says the RFP's Gen Z audience is a leftover from the previous agency's positioning and the real buyer is 25 to 40 urban professionals; this correction is made verbally only.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The target audience drives channel, tone and creative, and it differs from the RFP.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε ότι το κοινό-στόχος είναι αστοί επαγγελματίες 25 έως 40 ετών και ότι το Gen Z του RFP δεν ισχύει πλέον;

open_questions.gap: Deliverables were described only as "some videos and social stuff", with no formats, quantities or channels.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Production scope and cost cannot be estimated without concrete outputs.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποια formats, πόσα κομμάτια και ποια κανάλια περιμένετε από τα videos και το social, ή θέλετε να τα προτείνουμε εμείς;

open_questions.gap: A TikTok dance idea was floated as a passing thought, explicitly not to be held to and not yet discussed internally.
open_questions.why_it_matters: It should not enter scope as a commitment unless the client decides it should.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Η ιδέα με το TikTok dance ήταν απλώς σκέψη; Θέλετε να την εξετάσουμε ή να την αφήσουμε εκτός;

open_questions.gap: The timing is only "φθινόπωρο" and "κάπου εκεί", in reply to the RFP's October; no exact launch date or milestones were given.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Production and media planning depend on a fixed launch date.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Το launch είναι για τον Οκτώβριο όπως έγραφε το RFP; Υπάρχει συγκεκριμένη ημερομηνία ή παράθυρο;

open_questions.gap: The board meeting that will finalise the timing is dated only as "τέλη του μήνα", a relative date.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The board decision is a gate for the timeline, so its date sets when planning can be locked.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Με το «τέλη του μήνα» εννοείτε τέλη Ιουλίου 2026, δηλαδή 31 Ιουλίου; Τι ακριβώς θα αποφασίσει το board;

open_questions.gap: The figure is a hedged range ("κάπου στα ογδόντα, μπορεί ογδόντα πέντε") with no stated currency or units, and it excludes media spend. Scope (production only or not) and VAT treatment are not stated.
open_questions.why_it_matters: We cannot size production or the deliverable mix without knowing the amount, currency and what it covers.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε: το 80–85 αφορά χιλιάδες ευρώ; Είναι μόνο για production, και είναι με ή χωρίς ΦΠΑ;

open_questions.gap: Media spend is handled separately with the client's media shop, and the CFO said the figure is not yet hers; it is unknown.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Channel mix and reach targets depend on the media budget, which is kept distinct from production.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιος στο media shop σας αποφασίζει το media spend και πότε θα έχουμε ένα εύρος για να σχεδιάσουμε τα κανάλια;

open_questions.gap: The key visual direction was spoken as «κι βίζουαλ», a probable garble of "key visual". "Premium καλοκαίρι" is not defined.
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the only creative constraint stated so far, and it is a garbled token to be confirmed before it is treated as a rule.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Εννοείτε ότι το key visual πρέπει να φωνάζει καλοκαίρι αλλά με premium αισθητική; Έχετε παραδείγματα του τι σημαίνει για εσάς «premium καλοκαίρι»;

value_a.anchor: ίσως κάνουμε OOH στις στάσεις του μετρό

internal_conflicts.note: The same speaker explicitly retracted his own OOH metro-stops idea about 20 seconds later ("Ξεχάστε το"), giving cost as the reason. The reversal is settled, so no open question is raised; the trail is kept here and OOH is not carried into deliverables.
